DriveThruRPG to Offer Paizo’s Title Catalog

DM Shawn
August 12, 2026
0

Over 1,200 PDF titles are now available on DriveThruRPG + Pathfinder Infinite – with over a thousand more to follow

Henderson, Nevada & Redmond, Washington – Aug 12, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:49
Instaread

Paizo and DriveThruRPG expand their partnership to offer Paizo’s full title catalog in PDF from both DriveThruRPG and the Pathfinder and Starfinder Infinite marketplaces. Over 1,200 Pathfinder and Starfinder titles will now be available as PDF, with printed options and connections to Paizo’s store coming soon. These PDFs include the latest Pathfinder and Starfinder second edition remastered titles, as well as first edition materials, fiction, and audiobooks. This will give players the chance to dive deeper into the world of Golarion or the Pact Worlds, opening up new adventures and creativity to bring to the table.

Paizo and DriveThruRPG have a long history of working together, most notably on the Pathfinder and Starfinder Infinite programs and marketplaces which offer independent creators the opportunity to publish works within the official Pathfinder and Starfinder settings. Until now however, Paizo’s own official titles were not available on DriveThruRPG.

“It feels like Spotify getting to offer the Beatles,” said DriveThruRPG founder Steve Wieck, “for the past twenty years, Paizo has had an unrivaled publication of top-tier roleplaying titles, and we’re honored to help bring those titles to an even broader audience of roleplaying game fans.”

The companies also announced that in the months ahead, DriveThruRPG would also offer most Paizo titles for sale in print, and that the companies would be implementing Paizo Connect. With Paizo Connect, customers will have the option to connect their accounts at Paizo’s website with DriveThruRPG and sync their PDF libraries and purchases across both sites. Ownership of PDFs offer Paizo fans several benefits with Paizo and its licensed partners, while ownership on DriveThruRPG allows fans the conveniences of DriveThruRPG’s library including apps to keep your library up to date on PCs and devices.

“Expanding our partnership with DriveThruRPG makes it easier for more players to discover and enjoy Pathfinder and Starfinder,” said Jim Butler, CEO of Paizo. “We’re excited to bring decades of Paizo releases to the DriveThruRPG community, with even more options ahead.”

About Paizo

Paizo Inc. publishes the award-winning Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, Pathfinder Adventure Card Game, Pathfinder Tales novels, and the Starfinder science-fantasy roleplaying game, along with various board games and accessories. Since its founding over 15 years ago, Paizo has received more than 100 major awards and is recognized as a leading company in the hobby games industry.

About DriveThruRPG

DriveThruRPG is the largest online marketplace for RPGs and related materials. DriveThruRPG is the largest online marketplace for RPGs and related materials. We offer over ten thousand roleplaying titles from thousands of publishers, including major companies like Wizards of the Coast, Chaosium, and White Wolf, as well as innovative small presses.
